scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.desktop: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run dist
scripts.setup:host: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/dist/setup-host.js
